start query
"SELECT * 
FROM student.enrollments 
WHERE student_id IN (
    SELECT student_id 
    FROM student.enrollments 
    GROUP BY student_id 
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
ORDER BY student_id;
"
end query
